notes: Two taḥwīl-linked branches. «عن الأعمش، عن إبراهيم، عن همام» is written once after the last «ح» (in «قال أخبرنا أبو معاوية»), so it is the shared tail of both branches.

Jarir is the last link: Hammam relays his act and his words «فقال نعم رأيت رسول الله»; this is read as a Companion quoted as a witness (rule 6). The later «قال إبراهيم كان يعجبهم» is a comment, not a route. «واللفظ ليحيى» is a wording preference.
«قال أخبرنا أبو معاوية» repeats the Abu Mu'awiya of the branch and is one link (rule 7).
